references.text: The daughters of Zelophehad come forward before Moses and demand their inheritance rights, since their father died without sons. This is the direct continuation of the case introduced in Num 26:33.

Further legislation concerning the daughters of Zelophehad regarding marriage within the tribe to preserve the inheritance. The five daughters are named by name: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah and Noah.
The daughters of Zelophehad receive their inheritance in the tribe of Manasseh, as fulfillment of the Lord's command through Moses. The same five names are mentioned.
Zelophehad is mentioned in the genealogy of Manasseh, with reference to the fact that he had only daughters.
